notes: EastMoney provides the A-share listing dates. Tencent provides backward-adjusted daily closing prices (hfq).
The trading calendar follows observed Shanghai Composite sessions. We use mainland A-share prices, including where a company also has Hong Kong shares.

The 2015 closing values are used only to measure the first return in 2016. Adjusted prices are used as return proxies; they are not current share prices or a separately reconstructed dividend-reinvestment series.
The company list was supplied for this research. We have not applied a separate historical market-cap or liquidity screen.
